title: Trump Says the Economy Is Good. Is It?

sentences.zh: 太空探索的七十年。

sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，享受nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittrowev.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: A new poll shows more Americans than ever disapprove of President Trump's handling of the economy.
sentences.zh: 一项新的民意调查显示，越来越多的美国人对特朗普总统处理经济的方式表示不满。

sentences.en: This week, all eyes have been on the economy.
sentences.zh: 本周，所有人的目光都聚焦在经济上。

sentences.en: Me and my husband just left the grocery store.
sentences.zh: 我和我丈夫刚从杂货店出来。

sentences.en: Everything has just went up double.
sentences.zh: 所有东西的价格都翻了一倍。

sentences.en: This is getting crazy.
sentences.zh: 这简直疯了。

sentences.en: We can't even afford groceries anymore.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至连杂货都买不起了。

sentences.en: To put 20% down on our house, that's a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 买房要付20%的首付，那可是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: Even I can't do it.
sentences.zh: 连我都拿不出来。

sentences.en: We're a double shift.
sentences.zh: 我们得打两份工。

sentences.en: I'm 70 years old.
sentences.zh: 我今年70岁了。

sentences.en: I cannot afford to retire.
sentences.zh: 我根本退不了休。

sentences.en: With anxieties over affordability building,
sentences.zh: 随着对生活负担能力的焦虑日益加剧，

sentences.en: President Trump made a push to reassure Americans.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统试图安抚美国民众。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: labor market is showing further signs of cooling as the latest jobs report shows unemployment rising to 4.6 percent.
sentences.zh: 劳动力市场显示出进一步降温的迹象，最新的就业报告显示失业率上升至4.6%。

sentences.en: Just as the government released long-awaited data that raised new questions about the economic health of the nation.
sentences.zh: 就在政府发布了备受期待的数据之际，这些数据引发了对国家经济健康状况的新质疑。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues Tony Rahm on how Trump is trying to take control of the issue that's become his biggest political vulnerability.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事托尼·拉姆将探讨特朗普如何试图掌控这一已成为他最大政治软肋的问题。

sentences.en: And Ben Castleman on what the latest numbers tell us about why people are still so frustrated.
sentences.zh: 本·卡斯尔曼将分析最新数据告诉我们，为什么人们仍然感到如此沮丧。

sentences.en: It's Friday, December 19th.
sentences.zh: 今天是12月19日，星期五。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show, Tony.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目，托尼。

sentences.en: It's great to have you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: Hey, thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 嘿，谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: There's been a lot of focus on the economy recently, especially since the November election, when voters made it very clear that affordability was a major concern for them,
sentences.zh: 最近人们对经济的关注度很高，特别是在11月大选之后，选民们非常明确地表示，负担能力是他们主要关心的问题，

sentences.en: that they were stressed and anxious about it.
sentences.zh: 他们对此感到压力和焦虑。

sentences.en: And for the past few weeks, we've seen the administration go out and talk a lot about these concerns, including in an address to the nation by Trump on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 在过去几周里，我们看到政府出面谈论了很多这些担忧，包括特朗普周三向全国发表的讲话。

sentences.en: So please, Tony, walk us through what exactly Trump and his allies are saying.
sentences.zh: 那么，托尼，请为我们梳理一下特朗普及其盟友到底在说什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is really an attempt by President Trump to try to reclaim the narrative on affordability.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实是特朗普总统试图夺回关于负担能力叙事权的一次尝试。

sentences.en: And this is all happening right now because voters increasingly report that they're frustrated with President Trump's handling of the economy and they're frustrated with the fact
sentences.zh: 这一切之所以发生，是因为选民们越来越多地表示，他们对特朗普总统处理经济的方式感到沮丧，而且他们对

sentences.en: that prices continue to remain so stubbornly high.
sentences.zh: 物价持续居高不下感到不满。

sentences.en: And so within the last couple of weeks, we've seen President Trump start to hit the road to sell his economic agenda.
sentences.zh: 因此，在过去几周内，我们看到特朗普总统开始四处奔走，推销他的经济议程。

sentences.en: I just want to say hello, Pennsylvania, and I'm thrilled to be back.
sentences.zh: 我只想说，你好，宾夕法尼亚州，我很高兴能回来。

sentences.en: The first of those appearances came on December 9th when the president traveled to Pennsylvania, an important electoral battleground,
sentences.zh: 这些行程中的第一次是在12月9日，当时总统前往重要的选举战场宾夕法尼亚州，

sentences.en: to try to talk to voters about the work that he has done to bring down prices and to boost jobs.
sentences.zh: 试图与选民谈论他在降低物价和促进就业方面所做的工作。

sentences.en: The speech ended up lasting more than an hour and it saw the president touch on many topics far outside the context of the economy, including windmills and transgender people
sentences.zh: 演讲持续了一个多小时，总统谈到了许多远离经济背景的话题，包括风力发电机、跨性别群体，

sentences.en: and even his relationship with the Philadelphia Eagles running back,
sentences.zh: 甚至还有他与费城老鹰队跑卫的关系，

sentences.en: Saquon Barkley.
sentences.zh: 萨昆·巴克利。

sentences.en: By the way, if I read for it on the telepromp, do you all be falling asleep right now?
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，如果我照着提词器读，你们现在是不是都睡着了？

sentences.en: The president had a really hard time staying on message.
sentences.zh: 总统在保持演讲主题一致方面确实遇到了困难。

sentences.en: You know, because I love the weave, the weave.
sentences.zh: 你知道，因为我喜欢这种“编织”手法，这种编织。

sentences.en: You know what the weave is?
sentences.zh: 你知道什么是编织吗？

sentences.en: You go here, bing, bing, bing, bing.
sentences.zh: 你从这儿开始，砰、砰、砰、砰。

sentences.en: You always have to get back to the right location.
sentences.zh: 你总是得回到正确的位置。

sentences.en: Now, President Trump did turn to the economy several times during his speech.
sentences.zh: 现在，特朗普总统在演讲中确实多次提到了经济问题。

sentences.en: And on the issue of affordability...
sentences.zh: 关于负担能力的问题……

sentences.en: They have a new word.
sentences.zh: 他们有个新词。

sentences.en: You know, they always have a hoax.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们总是有个骗局。

sentences.en: The new word is affordability.
sentences.zh: 这个新词就是“负担能力”。

sentences.en: He called it a hoax.
sentences.zh: 他称之为骗局。

sentences.en: So they look at the camera and they say, this election is all about affordability.
sentences.zh: 所以他们对着镜头说，这次选举完全是关于负担能力的。

sentences.en: Which is something the president has said repeatedly in recent weeks as he tries to deflect attention on the fact that prices continue to remain high even under his leadership.
sentences.zh: 这是总统最近几周反复提到的话，因为他试图转移人们对他领导下物价依然高企这一事实的注意力。

sentences.en: He even said that people should purchase fewer dolls and fewer pencils if they're looking to get away from higher prices.
sentences.zh: 他甚至说，如果人们想避开高物价，就应该少买玩偶和铅笔。

sentences.en: It sounds like the speech was overall pretty undisciplined by the president.
sentences.zh: 听起来总统的这次演讲总体上相当缺乏纪律。

sentences.en: And it was also him kind of trying to make this problem go away by insisting it doesn't even exiSt.
sentences.zh: 而且他似乎也试图通过坚称这个问题根本不存在来让它消失。

sentences.en: Like, nothing to see here.
sentences.zh: 就像是，这里没什么可看的。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's been the strategy of the White House.
sentences.zh: 是的，这一直是白宫的策略。

sentences.en: It's really been to deflect.
sentences.zh: 确实一直在转移视线。

sentences.en: Which is what made it so remarkable that just days later, on Wednesday night,
sentences.zh: 这使得几天后的周三晚上发生的事情显得格外引人注目，

sentences.en: President Trump gets up in front of the nation and tries to make his more forceful case for why the economy is in good shape and why his policies are working.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统站在全国人民面前，试图更有力地论证为什么经济状况良好，以及为什么他的政策行之有效。

sentences.en: 11 months ago, I inherited a mess.
sentences.zh: 11个月前，我接手的是一个烂摊子。

sentences.en: And I'm fixing it.
sentences.zh: 而我正在修复它。

sentences.en: And so what we got from the president was a roughly 18-minute speech in which he was more concise and spoke more to the issues of the economy.
sentences.zh: 所以总统发表了一场大约18分钟的演讲，他在演讲中更加简洁，更多地谈到了经济问题。

sentences.en: He brought up a lot of data, but some of that data was exaggerated or incorrect to make his record look better than it actually was in the economy.
sentences.zh: 他列举了大量数据，但其中一些数据被夸大或不准确，目的是让他的经济政绩看起来比实际更好。

sentences.en: When I took office, inflation was the worst in 48 years.
sentences.zh: 我上任时，通货膨胀是48年来最严重的。

sentences.en: And some would say, in the history of our country, which caused prices to be higher than ever before, making life unaffordable for millions and millions of Americans.
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至会说，是我们国家历史上最严重的，这导致物价高得前所未有，让数以百万计的美国人生活难以负担。

sentences.en: The president comes out and says that he has done extensive work to try to undo the inflation that we saw during the Biden administration,
sentences.zh: 总统出来说，他已经做了大量工作，试图扭转我们在拜登政府时期看到的通货膨胀，

sentences.en: and said that the work of his administration was going to take time, but had already resulted in rising wages and in lower prices for millions of Americans.
sentences.zh: 并表示他的政府所做的工作需要时间，但已经带来了工资上涨和数百万美国人生活成本降低的结果。

sentences.en: Tonight, after 11 months, our border is secure.
sentences.zh: 今晚，11个月后，我们的边境是安全的。

sentences.en: Inflation has stopped.
sentences.zh: 通货膨胀已经停止。

sentences.en: Wages are up.
sentences.zh: 工资在上涨。

sentences.en: Prices are down.
sentences.zh: 物价在下降。

sentences.en: Our nation is strong.
sentences.zh: 我们的国家很强大。

sentences.en: America is respected.
sentences.zh: 美国受到尊重。

sentences.en: And our country is back, stronger than ever before.
sentences.zh: 我们的国家回来了，比以往任何时候都更强大。

sentences.en: We're poised for an economic boom the likes of which the world has never seen.
sentences.zh: 我们正准备迎接一场世界前所未见的经济繁荣。

sentences.en: He said that he was going to have a whole new policy coming soon, meant to help lower housing costs.
sentences.zh: 他说他很快会出台一项全新的政策，旨在帮助降低住房成本。

sentences.en: He talked about how he was going to try to do the same thing with health care costs and had touted some recent work with respect to drug pricing.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了他将如何尝试在医疗成本方面做同样的事情，并吹捧了最近在药品定价方面的一些工作。

sentences.en: And perhaps most importantly, the president ditched the language where he was calling affordability a hoax.
sentences.zh: 或许最重要的是，总统放弃了将负担能力称为骗局的说法。

sentences.en: He wasn't in the position that he was only days earlier, where he was dismissing the whole issue of cost of living outright.
sentences.zh: 他不再像几天前那样，直接否定整个生活成本问题。

sentences.en: And what do you make of that, Tony, that he dropped the hoax language?
sentences.zh: 托尼，你觉得他放弃“骗局”这种说法意味着什么？

sentences.en: Do you think it's a sign that he's realizing that is not going to work?
sentences.zh: 你认为这是否表明他意识到那招行不通了？

sentences.en: People are not going to buy that this is a hoax because it's something they're actually living every day.
sentences.zh: 人们不会相信这是一个骗局，因为这是他们每天都在亲身经历的事情。

sentences.en: You know, it might be a sign that the White House's messaging is shifting a little bit on the economy as it recognizes that people really don't like being told
sentences.zh: 你知道，这可能表明白宫在经济问题上的口径正在发生一点变化，因为它意识到人们真的不喜欢被告知

sentences.en: that things are better than they are.
sentences.zh: 情况比实际情况要好。

sentences.en: But the underlying principle here is that the president believes his policies are working and that things like tariffs, for example, aren't causing prices to rise.
sentences.zh: 但这里的基本原则是，总统相信他的政策是有效的，而且像关税这样的事情并没有导致物价上涨。

sentences.en: And that philosophy hasn't changed.
sentences.zh: 这种哲学并没有改变。

sentences.en: And so while the way they're talking about it might be shifting right now because of public opinion, the policies that inform what they're doing
sentences.zh: 因此，虽然他们谈论此事的方式可能因为公众舆论而发生了变化，但指导他们行动的政策

sentences.en: have stayed the exact same for the most part.
sentences.zh: 在很大程度上保持不变。

sentences.en: They have told people to just hang tight and that the full weight of their agenda will start to take effect, especially into early next year.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉人们再坚持一下，他们的议程将全面发挥作用，特别是在明年年初。

sentences.en: And that's when people will start to see relief in the form of more jobs and bigger paychecks and so forth.
sentences.zh: 到那时，人们将开始看到以更多就业机会、更高薪水等形式带来的缓解。

sentences.en: And the give us more time request, like, what are they actually asking for the time to do?
sentences.zh: 关于“给我们更多时间”的请求，他们到底要求时间去做什么？

sentences.en: What's supposed to be happening next year that may help people feel differently in their estimation?
sentences.zh: 明年应该发生什么，可能会让人们在评估时有不同的感受？

sentences.en: So much of this rests on the implementation of the president's sprawling set of tax cuts that Congress adopted this summer.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上取决于总统今年夏天通过国会实施的一系列大规模减税措施。

sentences.en: That's when people may start to see some of the benefits that the president has touted in recent weeks.
sentences.zh: 到那时，人们可能会开始看到总统最近几周所吹捧的一些好处。

sentences.en: And that'll happen generally in two forMs.
sentences.zh: 这通常会以两种形式出现。

sentences.en: The first is that people are going to see bigger tax refunds because there are a number of perks in that tax cut package that will expand how much certain Americans,
sentences.zh: 首先，人们会看到更多的退税，因为减税方案中有许多福利，将扩大某些美国人，

sentences.en: like seniors, will receive when they file their taxes.
sentences.zh: 比如老年人，在报税时能获得的金额。

sentences.en: And so that's going to be a chunk of cash that people get.
sentences.zh: 所以那将是一笔人们能拿到的现金。

sentences.en: So that's actually true.
sentences.zh: 所以这实际上是真的。

sentences.en: That will happen.
sentences.zh: 这会发生的。

sentences.en: That will happen.
sentences.zh: 这会发生的。

sentences.en: Now, the amount that that happens will vary depending on the kind of person that files.
sentences.zh: 当然，发生的金额会根据报税人的类型而有所不同。

sentences.en: But people will see larger tax refunds.
sentences.zh: 但人们会看到更多的退税。

sentences.en: You know, the Trump administration also did not update the tables that determine how much is taken out of your paycheck throughout the year for federal taxes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，特朗普政府也没有更新决定全年从你的工资中扣除多少联邦税的税表。

sentences.en: So refunds will be larger in 2026 because of that, because people's paychecks were not adjusted in a way to reflect the work that Congress did wrapping up this past summer.
sentences.zh: 因此，2026年的退税额会更高，因为人们的工资扣缴没有根据国会今年夏天完成的工作进行调整。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And then beyond that, I think the administration believes that the implementation of that tax law and the work that they're continuing to do in areas like trade
sentences.zh: 除此之外，我认为政府相信该税法的实施以及他们在贸易等领域继续做的工作

sentences.en: will boost the work of companies to invest here in the United States, meaning more hiring and more domestic production.
sentences.zh: 将促进企业在美国本土投资，这意味着更多的招聘和更多的国内生产。

sentences.en: And that means more opportunities in areas like construction and manufacturing.
sentences.zh: 这意味着建筑和制造业等领域有更多的机会。

sentences.en: And that's why the administration says that it believes that the United States is on track to see some significant growth next year because of all of the money
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么政府表示，它相信美国有望在明年看到显著增长，因为所有的资金

sentences.en: it's pumping into the economy to stimulate that growth, particularly in the form of its tax law.
sentences.zh: 正在注入经济以刺激这种增长，特别是以税法的形式。

sentences.en: And it sounds like that could actually be quite meaningful, both for individuals who get, you know, this version of a stimulus check in the form of a bigger tax refund
sentences.zh: 听起来这确实可能意义重大，无论是对于那些以更多退税形式获得这种“刺激支票”的个人，

sentences.en: and for businesses, if they are able to channel some of those savings into hiring or growth.
sentences.zh: 还是对于那些能够将部分节省下来的资金用于招聘或扩张的企业来说。

sentences.en: What else is the administration banking on in 2026?
sentences.zh: 政府在2026年还指望什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, the president has talked for weeks about sending perhaps $2,000 rebate checks to Americans funded through the tariffs that the United States has collected
sentences.zh: 是的，总统几周来一直在谈论向美国人发放可能为2000美元的退税支票，资金来源于美国征收的关税，

sentences.en: as part of the president's trade war.
sentences.zh: 作为总统贸易战的一部分。

sentences.en: Hold on, how exactly would that work?
sentences.zh: 等等，那具体怎么运作？

sentences.en: Yeah, well, I think that's the question we're asking too.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想这也是我们想问的问题。

sentences.en: You know, the administration has said that it will be about a $2,000 check and that it would go to Americans who make under $100,000.
sentences.zh: 你知道，政府已经表示这将是一张大约2000美元的支票，将发给收入低于10万美元的美国人。

sentences.en: But that's all we have gotten from the White House.
sentences.zh: 但这就是我们从白宫得到的全部信息。

sentences.en: The president has talked about this since about July or so, but they haven't really put pen to paper on a policy.
sentences.zh: 总统从七月左右就开始谈论这件事，但他们并没有真正落实到具体的政策文件上。

sentences.en: And even on top of all that, there are some Republicans in Congress who are a little bit worried about that idea and aren't super supportive of it.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，国会中也有一些共和党人对这个想法感到担忧，并不是特别支持。

sentences.en: But the president has talked about it as one of the things that might put money in the hands of Americans in 2026, even though that could potentially worsen
sentences.zh: 但总统将其作为可能在2026年让美国人拿到钱的事情之一来谈论，尽管这可能会加剧

sentences.en: the problem of inflation that they're trying to resolve.
sentences.zh: 他们试图解决的通货膨胀问题。

sentences.en: The idea is that this check, in theory, would potentially offset the higher costs that people are paying because of his tariffs.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，这张支票理论上可能会抵消人们因他的关税而支付的更高成本。

sentences.en: It almost sounds like a way of kind of rebranding tariffs by saying to people, look, you get something out of this.
sentences.zh: 这听起来几乎像是通过告诉人们“看，你能从中得到好处”来重新包装关税的一种方式。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's interesting you use that phrasing because the president's own aides have sometimes framed it that way themselves.
sentences.zh: 是的，你用这个措辞很有意思，因为总统自己的助手有时也会这样表述。

sentences.en: They have said that this is the sort of thing that might help show Americans why tariffs are so rewarding for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这正是那种可能有助于向美国人展示为什么关税对美国政府如此有益的事情。

sentences.en: government.
sentences.zh: 政府。

sentences.en: But you're right,
sentences.zh: 但你是对的，

sentences.en: Republicans haven't expressed a great deal of support for this.
sentences.zh: 共和党人并没有对这一点表示太多的支持。

sentences.en: And it also remains unclear if the United States government can do this just given the legal issues that surround the president's tariffs right now.
sentences.zh: 而且，考虑到目前围绕总统关税的法律问题，美国政府能否做到这一点也尚不清楚。

sentences.en: I'm struck, Tony, that the messaging that you're describing from the White House, it is essentially telling people to hold tight.
sentences.zh: 托尼，我感到震惊的是，你所描述的来自白宫的信息，本质上是在告诉人们要坚持住。

sentences.en: Like, good times are around the corner, wait, hang on.
sentences.zh: 就像是，好日子就在眼前，等等，坚持住。

sentences.en: That demands a lot of patience from people who are saying, at this point, I am already looking at health care costs that are about to skyrocket.
sentences.zh: 这要求人们有极大的耐心，而这些人此时此刻说，我已经在面对即将飙升的医疗成本了。

sentences.en: I can't afford holiday gifts right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在负担不起节日礼物了。

sentences.en: My bills are too high this month.
sentences.zh: 这个月我的账单太高了。

sentences.en: And you're asking me to wait.
sentences.zh: 而你却让我再等等。

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: And it's not the first time that the administration has asked for that kind of patience.
sentences.zh: 而且这已经不是本届政府第一次要求民众保持这种耐心了。

sentences.en: You might remember earlier in the president's term when he first started introducing his tariffs, the message from the White House was there might be some short-term pain.
sentences.zh: 你可能还记得总统任期初期，当他刚开始推行关税政策时，白宫传达的信息是可能会有短期的阵痛。

sentences.en: But they said that was in the service of a better economy.
sentences.zh: 但他们说那是为了换取更好的经济前景。

sentences.en: And so we're now seeing what that pain looks like.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在看到了这种阵痛是什么样子的。

sentences.en: People are experiencing it.
sentences.zh: 人们正在经历它。

sentences.en: And the message that we're getting from voters as evidenced by some of the recent polling is they're frustrated with the pain.
sentences.zh: 正如最近的一些民调所显示的那样，我们从选民那里得到的信息是，他们对这种阵痛感到沮丧。

sentences.en: They're feeling it.
sentences.zh: 他们感同身受。

sentences.en: They don't like it.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: And they want to see the White House and this administration do more about it.
sentences.zh: 他们希望看到白宫和本届政府能为此采取更多行动。

sentences.en: But the message from the White House has been that they're going to stay the course because they believe that they have the recipe to lower prices and to boost the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但白宫传达的信息一直是他们将坚持既定方针，因为他们相信自己有降低物价和提振美国经济的良方。

sentences.en: economy.
sentences.zh: 经济。

sentences.en: And so there's a disconnect and there's a real risk for the administration.
sentences.zh: 因此，这里存在脱节，这对本届政府来说是一个真正的风险。

sentences.en: And it remains unclear if American families can hold on for as long as the Trump administration would like them to hold on as they pursue this vision of a better economy.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚美国家庭是否能像特朗普政府所希望的那样，在追求这种更好经济愿景的过程中坚持足够长的时间。

sentences.en: When we come back,
sentences.zh: 稍后回来，

sentences.en: Ben Castleman on what the latest data actually shows about the current state of the economy and what Trump gets right and wrong about it.
sentences.zh: 本·卡斯尔曼将为您解读最新数据揭示的当前经济状况，以及特朗普对经济的看法中有哪些正确和错误之处。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏中的“Connections”谜题。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我还喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazurski.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作“Spelling Bee”和“Letterboxd”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Ben, we've heard that Trump is asking people at this moment to hold on and wait for better times.
sentences.zh: 本，我们听说特朗普目前正在要求人们坚持住，等待更好的时光到来。

sentences.en: And that that is complicated by the fact that in this economy, many people are hurting.
sentences.zh: 而这一点因为当前经济中许多人正在受苦的事实而变得复杂。

sentences.en: That's something that's reflected in polling.
sentences.zh: 这在民调中有所反映。

sentences.en: It's something that is just a reality that I think we all see in people's experiences these days.
sentences.zh: 我认为这只是我们如今在人们的经历中都能看到的现实。

sentences.en: You have been looking at the data.
sentences.zh: 你一直在研究这些数据。

sentences.en: And so based on that, why do you think people are feeling so bad about the economy at this moment?
sentences.zh: 那么基于此，你认为为什么人们此刻对经济感觉如此糟糕？

sentences.en: I think there are two answers to that question.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个问题有两个答案。

sentences.en: The first is that by most measures, things are actually worse today than they were a year ago.
sentences.zh: 首先，从大多数指标来看，今天的情况实际上比一年前更糟。

sentences.en: Unemployment is higher.
sentences.zh: 失业率更高了。

sentences.en: Wage growth is slower.
sentences.zh: 工资增长放缓了。

sentences.en: Consumer spending is growing more slowly.
sentences.zh: 消费支出增长变慢了。

sentences.en: Inflation is still stubbornly high.
sentences.zh: 通胀依然顽固地处于高位。

sentences.en: And so the economy by the sort of standard measures that we use is not a disaster.
sentences.zh: 所以，按照我们使用的那种标准衡量指标来看，经济并非一场灾难。

sentences.en: It's not falling off a cliff, but it has deteriorated.
sentences.zh: 它没有跌落悬崖，但确实已经恶化了。

sentences.en: And a gradual deterioration is still a deterioration.
sentences.zh: 而逐渐的恶化依然是恶化。

sentences.en: It's not surprising that people wouldn't feel terrific about a deterioration.
sentences.zh: 人们对这种恶化感到不爽，这并不令人惊讶。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: But then the second reason is that all of the things that I hear the most when I talk to Americans about what bothers them,
sentences.zh: 但第二个原因是，当我与美国人交谈时，听到最多的是关于困扰他们的事情，

sentences.en: this sense that housing has gotten expensive, that child care and elder care and health care are all unaffordable, that their incomes are not delivering for them
sentences.zh: 这种感觉就是住房变得昂贵，育儿、养老和医疗都负担不起，他们的收入无法为他们提供

sentences.en: the kind of middle-class life that they had hoped for and expected.
sentences.zh: 他们所期望和预想的那种中产阶级生活。

sentences.en: None of that has gotten better.
sentences.zh: 这些问题一个都没有好转。

sentences.en: And some of it has gotten worse.
sentences.zh: 甚至有些还变得更糟了。

sentences.en: Now, those are long-run probleMs.
sentences.zh: 现在，这些都是长期存在的问题。

sentences.en: And I don't think anybody thought that Donald Trump was going to come in and in 12 months fix all of these long-standing probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我不认为有人会认为唐纳德·特朗普上台后能在12个月内解决所有这些长期存在的问题。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But to the extent that they really haven't improved, that he hasn't even really talked very much about them,
sentences.zh: 但在这些问题确实没有改善，甚至他本人都没有怎么谈论过它们的程度上，

sentences.en: I don't think it's that surprising that people emerge from that and say, I don't feel good about where things are.
sentences.zh: 我不认为人们对此感到不满有什么好奇怪的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: These are like open wounds that they're saying have not been treated.
sentences.zh: 这些就像是他们所说的尚未得到处理的开放性伤口。

sentences.en: Have not been treated and the administration is being really quite dismissive of.
sentences.zh: 尚未得到处理，而且政府对此表现得相当不屑一顾。

sentences.en: So, we just got new numbers on several of these issues that, as you mentioned, have been long-standing pain points for people.
sentences.zh: 那么，我们刚刚收到了关于其中几个问题的最新数据，正如你所提到的，这些一直是人们长期以来的痛点。

sentences.en: So, can you just walk us through what they tell us about where we stand on these issues?
sentences.zh: 那么，你能为我们梳理一下这些数据告诉我们目前在这些问题上处于什么位置吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's been a huge week for economic data, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，这对经济数据来说是重要的一周，对吧？

sentences.en: We went for an extended period with no numbers because of the government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 由于政府停摆，我们有一段时间没有数据了。

sentences.en: And so, we're sort of finally getting it all flooding back in.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们终于看到所有数据又涌回来了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we're trying to make sense of what it all means.
sentences.zh: 我们正在努力弄清楚这一切意味着什么。

sentences.en: Start with the jobs report that we got on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 先从周二发布的就业报告说起。

sentences.en: It showed that job growth was actually okay in November.
sentences.zh: 它显示11月份的就业增长实际上还可以。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: But the unemployment rate rose to 4.6%.
sentences.zh: 但失业率上升到了4.6%。

sentences.en: That's the highest since we were emerging from the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这是自疫情结束以来最高的水平。

sentences.en: How do you parse that?
sentences.zh: 你如何解读这一点？

sentences.en: So, I think what it tells us is that the labor market is stuck.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为它告诉我们的是，劳动力市场陷入了停滞。

sentences.en: And it's been stuck for kind of a while.
sentences.zh: 而且这种停滞已经持续了一段时间。

sentences.en: We hear about layoffs, right?
sentences.zh: 我们听到了裁员的消息，对吧？

sentences.en: We hear about big companies that are cutting jobs.
sentences.zh: 我们听说大公司正在削减工作岗位。

sentences.en: But if you look at the data, layoffs have really not been very high.
sentences.zh: 但如果你看数据，裁员率其实并不高。

sentences.en: In fact, they've been quite low.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它们一直很低。

sentences.en: So, if you've got a job, you don't seem to be at that much risk of losing it right now.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你有一份工作，目前看来你失去它的风险并不大。

sentences.en: But there's very little hiring going on.
sentences.zh: 但招聘活动非常少。

sentences.en: Economists talk about this as a low-hire, low-fire environment.
sentences.zh: 经济学家称这是一种低招聘、低解雇的环境。

sentences.en: So, if you're looking for a job, if you're just graduating from college or from high school, if you're trying to reenter the workforce after a time out, you know, raising children,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你正在找工作，如果你刚从大学或高中毕业，如果你在休息一段时间（比如抚养孩子）后试图重返职场，你知道，

sentences.en: if you have been unemployed and now you're trying to get back into the workforce, it's a really hard time to do that.
sentences.zh: 如果你之前失业了，现在正试图重返职场，这是一个非常艰难的时期。

sentences.en: And if you do have a job, okay, you're holding on to it,
sentences.zh: 如果你确实有一份工作，好吧，你保住了它，

sentences.en: but you're probably not getting much of a raise right now.
sentences.zh: 但你现在可能并没有得到多少加薪。

sentences.en: And what's the best way to get a raise?
sentences.zh: 那么获得加薪的最佳方式是什么？

sentences.en: It's to go and find another job, change jobs, or tell your boss, like, hey,
sentences.zh: 那就是去寻找另一份工作，跳槽，或者告诉你的老板，嘿，

sentences.en: I've got another offer.
sentences.zh: 我拿到了另一个录用通知。

sentences.en: If there aren't a lot of offers out there, you're not getting that raise and you're probably feeling pretty nervous, right?
sentences.zh: 如果市场上没有很多录用机会，你就得不到加薪，而且你可能会感到非常紧张，对吧？

sentences.en: You're like, if I do lose my job, I don't know that I'm going to be able to find a new one.
sentences.zh: 你会想，如果我真的丢了工作，我不知道自己是否还能找到一份新的。

sentences.en: And so, there's a real reason for people to have a level of anxiety over the labor market even though it's sort of not that bad in an absolute sense.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们对劳动力市场感到焦虑是有真正原因的，尽管从绝对意义上讲，它并没有那么糟糕。

sentences.en: There's a kind of stagnancy there.
sentences.zh: 那里存在一种停滞感。

sentences.en: You use the word stuck that helps explain why people are feeling negatively.
sentences.zh: 你用了“停滞”这个词，这有助于解释为什么人们会有负面情绪。

sentences.en: What about inflation?
sentences.zh: 那通货膨胀呢？

sentences.en: We just got that report.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚收到了那份报告。

sentences.en: On the surface, the numbers were really pretty good.
sentences.zh: 从表面上看，数据确实相当不错。

sentences.en: Inflation slowed.
sentences.zh: 通胀放缓了。

sentences.en: Prices were up
sentences.zh: 物价上涨了

sentences.en: 2.7% from a year ago.
sentences.zh: 2.7%，与一年前相比。

sentences.en: That's still above where we'd like to see it, but significantly better than it's been in quite a while.
sentences.zh: 这仍然高于我们希望看到的水平，但比过去很长一段时间要好得多。

sentences.en: So, good news for the administration.
sentences.zh: 所以，这对政府来说是个好消息。

sentences.en: Good news for the administration.
sentences.zh: 这对政府来说是个好消息。

sentences.en: And as you might imagine, the White House was out there right away talking about how the president has solved inflation.
sentences.zh: 正如你所料，白宫立即出来大谈总统是如何解决通胀问题的。

sentences.en: But if you talk to most economists, they will say, read these numbers with a lot of caution.
sentences.zh: 但如果你和大多数经济学家交谈，他们会说，要非常谨慎地解读这些数字。

sentences.en: And that the bigger picture on inflation is that it has cooled.
sentences.zh: 通胀的大局是它已经降温了。

sentences.en: It's not looking as bad as some people feared that it would.
sentences.zh: 情况看起来并没有一些人担心的那么糟糕。

sentences.en: But we're coming off of this period where inflation was really high.
sentences.zh: 但我们刚刚经历了一段通胀非常高的时期。

sentences.en: Grocery prices are up 25% over the past five years.
sentences.zh: 过去五年食品杂货价格上涨了25%。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So the fact that they're only up
sentences.zh: 所以，仅仅因为它们在过去一年里只上涨了

sentences.en: 2% over the last year doesn't make people feel great.
sentences.zh: 2%，并不能让人们感觉很好。

sentences.en: And there's still these sort of isolated categories where you see big price increases.
sentences.zh: 而且仍然存在一些孤立的类别，你可以看到价格大幅上涨。

sentences.en: Beef prices are up something like 15% over the past year.
sentences.zh: 牛肉价格在过去一年里上涨了大约15%。

sentences.en: And look, on one level, an economist is going to say, well, you can always cherry pick one price or another that's up a bunch.
sentences.zh: 看，从某种层面上讲，经济学家会说，好吧，你总是可以挑出某一种价格大幅上涨的商品。

sentences.en: But if you're a shopper who has experienced this increase in prices over the last few years and now you go and look at a pack of ground beef and it's so much more expensive
sentences.zh: 但如果你是一个在过去几年里经历了物价上涨的消费者，现在你去看看一包碎牛肉，它比几个月前贵了那么多，

sentences.en: than it was a few months ago, you're going to say, I can't believe this is still happening.
sentences.zh: 你会说，我简直不敢相信这种情况还在发生。

sentences.en: And I think that's what we're hearing from voters right now.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是我们现在从选民那里听到的声音。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Things getting a little better this year doesn't feel like all that much of an improvement when you're looking at something just becoming so much more expensive over the course
sentences.zh: 当你看到某些东西在最近的历史进程中变得如此昂贵时，今年情况稍微好转一点并不觉得有什么太大的改善。

sentences.en: of very recent history.
sentences.zh: 历史。

sentences.en: Yeah, and remember, prices are still rising.
sentences.zh: 是的，而且要记住，物价仍在上涨。

sentences.en: They're just rising more slowly than they were.
sentences.zh: 它们只是比以前上涨得慢了一些。

sentences.en: And so, if you're out there grocery shopping, you're not saying, like, aha, finally things are getting better.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你在外面买菜，你不会说，啊哈，情况终于好转了。

sentences.en: You're just saying, oh, well, they're getting worse a little bit more slowly than they were before.
sentences.zh: 你只会说，哦，好吧，它们恶化的速度比以前稍微慢了一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, still doesn't feel good.
sentences.zh: 是的，感觉依然不好。

sentences.en: And I think that brings us to the other big data point that came out this week, which was retail sales data.
sentences.zh: 我认为这把我们带到了本周发布的另一个重要数据点，即零售销售数据。

sentences.en: Consumer spending has been quite strong by all reports the holiday season looks like it's been a very strong season for spending.
sentences.zh: 据所有报道称，消费支出相当强劲，节日季看起来是一个非常强劲的消费季节。

sentences.en: But if you sort of drill down on those numbers, it's really being driven by a relative handful of high-income spenders.
sentences.zh: 但如果你深入研究这些数字，你会发现它实际上是由少数高收入消费者推动的。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: If you've got money in the stock market, if you own a home, right, you're feeling pretty good, you're spending freely, everyone else is sort of feeling that pinch, right,
sentences.zh: 如果你在股市里有钱，如果你拥有一套房子，对吧，你感觉相当不错，你在自由消费，而其他人都在感受到那种压力，对吧，

sentences.en: of higher prices, of weaker wage growth, of nervousness about the state of the economy.
sentences.zh: 物价上涨、工资增长疲软、对经济状况的担忧。

sentences.en: And so we're seeing sort of a lot of evidence of this bifurcation in the economy where one well-off group is spending freely, everybody else is feeling a bit more nervous.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到了很多证据表明经济出现了这种分化，一个富裕群体在自由消费，而其他人则感到更加紧张。

sentences.en: So even if consumer spending looks pretty good on the whole, baked in there, if you look under the hood, it's actually not that rosy of a picture.
sentences.zh: 所以即使消费支出总体看起来不错，但如果你仔细观察，就会发现情况其实并没有那么乐观。

sentences.en: There's many people that aren't spending as much as they were.
sentences.zh: 有很多人并没有像以前那样消费了。

sentences.en: That's right, and I think that really speaks to something that's happening in this economy broadly right now.
sentences.zh: 没错，我认为这确实说明了目前整个经济中正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: The unemployment rate is relatively low, but it's risen a lot recently for black workers, for young people, right?
sentences.zh: 失业率相对较低，但最近对于黑人劳动者和年轻人来说，失业率上升了很多，对吧？

sentences.en: Spending is strong in the aggregate, but that's being driven by people at the top.
sentences.zh: 总体支出强劲，但这主要是由顶层人群推动的。

sentences.en: Incomes are rising, but a lot of that is stock market gains, not wage gains.
sentences.zh: 收入在增加，但其中很大一部分是股市收益，而不是工资增长。

sentences.en: There are these pockets of the economy where we're seeing real evidence of strain.
sentences.zh: 经济中存在一些我们看到真正压力迹象的领域。

sentences.en: Is it possible then to actually get a wholesale picture of the economy if things are so segmented as you're describing?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果经济像你描述的那样细分，是否有可能真正获得一个整体的经济图景？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, look, the economy is always made up of all these different groups and different industries and different people experiencing different things, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，我是说，看，经济总是由所有这些不同的群体、不同的行业和不同的人经历着不同的事情组成的，对吧？

sentences.en: And so on some level,
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上讲，

sentences.en: my job, economists' job, right, is to step back and try to put it into some sort of larger context.
sentences.zh: 我的工作，经济学家的工作，对吧，就是退后一步，试图将其置于某种更大的背景中。

sentences.en: And when we do that right now, I think it's worth recognizing that there's actually a lot of resilience here that maybe we didn't fully expect.
sentences.zh: 当我们现在这样做时，我认为值得承认的是，这里实际上有很多我们可能没有完全预料到的韧性。

sentences.en: If you think back to the spring, there was a lot of fear that we were going to plunge into a recession, that unemployment was going to skyrocket, that hiring was going to stop,
sentences.zh: 如果你回想春天，当时人们非常担心我们会陷入衰退，失业率会飙升，招聘会停止，

sentences.en: and that is not really what we've seen.
sentences.zh: 而这并不是我们真正看到的。

sentences.en: It doesn't look like we're in a recession.
sentences.zh: 看起来我们并没有陷入衰退。

sentences.en: Unemployment has risen, but it's not super high.
sentences.zh: 失业率有所上升，但并没有高得离谱。

sentences.en: Spending is held up relatively okay in the aggregate.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，消费支出表现尚可。

sentences.en: So this isn't a picture of the whole economy pitching off a cliff.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不是说整个经济正在坠入悬崖。

sentences.en: It's a picture of things getting kind of gradually worse instead of better and looking pretty grim for some groups.
sentences.zh: 这反映出情况在逐渐恶化，而非好转，对某些群体来说前景相当严峻。

sentences.en: And I think in that context, it's understandable that people aren't jumping up and down and cheering about the state of the economy.
sentences.zh: 我认为在这种背景下，人们对经济现状感到不满是可以理解的。

sentences.en: Right, and just to turn back to
sentences.zh: 没错，回到

sentences.en: Trump's predicament in this moment, it's not a very easy sell to kind of turn around to people and say, look, it's not as bad as was predicted.
sentences.zh: 特朗普目前的困境，要转过身去告诉人们“看，情况没预想的那么糟”，这并不是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: You know, it's hard to go to a voter and sell them on your economic agenda with a message like that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很难去向选民推销你的经济议程，用这样的口吻。

sentences.en: We just came through four years of a
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚经历了四年的

sentences.en: Biden presidency that taught us that exact lesson, right?
sentences.zh: 拜登总统任期，这给了我们深刻的教训，对吧？

sentences.en: It's hard to tell people, imagine how much worse it could have been or to say, actually, things are pretty good once you stop and think about it.
sentences.zh: 很难去告诉人们“想象一下情况本可能有多糟”，或者说“其实当你静下心来想想，情况还不错”。

sentences.en: Could those actually be enough to change people's outlook or potentially turn around any of the trends we've been discussing?
sentences.zh: 这些钱真的足以改变人们的预期，或者扭转我们一直在讨论的任何趋势吗？

sentences.en: In the short term, yes, maybe.
sentences.zh: 短期内，是的，也许吧。

sentences.en: You know, people like getting money.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们喜欢拿到钱。

sentences.en: And when money flows into the economy, it ripples through and has wide reaching effects, right?

sentences.en: Businesses are going to take in that money and maybe hire more workers as a result and those people get more paychecks, right?
sentences.zh: 企业会收到这些钱，或许因此雇佣更多员工，而这些人又会拿到更多工资，对吧？

sentences.en: This is the classic virtuous circle that happens in the case of economic stimulus, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是经济刺激中典型的良性循环，对吧？

sentences.en: We've seen this before.
sentences.zh: 我们以前见过这种情况。

sentences.en: We saw it during the pandemic.

sentences.en: There's no reason to think that those sort of economic laws don't apply now.

sentences.en: activity.

sentences.zh: 所以，我认为当我们退后一步来看，说“是的，有理由认为明年的经济可能会比今年好”，如果这是真的，

sentences.zh: 但我们目前看到的任何东西都无法触及那些根本性问题，这些问题多年来一直让美国人觉得这个经济体
